title: Hudson x David weekly
notes_markdown:
### Pilot build status (target: Sun Oct 4)

- Canvas flicker fixed (per-block trail store + memoized blocks); 1,200-block test canvas scrolls smoothly
- Importers in build: Claude, ChatGPT, Zotero, Local PDFs, "Other" (zip/folder upload)
- Import summary card done: counts per source, skipped-with-reason list, possible duplicates
- Not done: suggestion ranking is still naive (BM25 over titles + first 2k chars); fine for pilots

### Known gaps to tell pilots up front

- Claude Projects come in as loose conversations (no project membership)
- No Google Drive (use "Other" → upload)
- Dedupe: exact hash + "possible duplicate" badge only

### Pilot script (David's doc)

- 10 min setup tour → 20 min live connect + import → 15 min writing task with trail
- Observe: hesitation on connect screen, surprise at counts, first confirmed suggestion (time it)
- Hudson runs Granola + takes timestamps; David drives the conversation

### Demo night draft

- Sent rough 4-minute bullets to Lena (on time-ish, Sep 30 late)

### Action items

- [ ] David — full import on own accounts Sat Oct 3, file bugs
- [ ] Hudson — pilot build deployed to staging by Sun noon
- [ ] Hudson — send Priya calendar invite + what to bring (one paragraph in progress)
- [ ] David — finish UIST slides before dry run Sunday
